data.long_meaning: Jethu is a Marathi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'jata', which means 'born'. It is used to address a younger brother. In Hindu mythology, Jethu is associated with Lord Vishnu and represents love, kindness, and care towards younger siblings. The name Jethu carries the meaning “Younger brother” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Marathi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jethu usually hope their child will grow to embody younger brother and live with faith, good character and purpose.
